title: Canonical Proposal
description: Compact immutable proposal for the AdCP 3.2 lifecycle. commercial_terms is the sole authoritative commercial envelope; narrative fields do not duplicate legacy allocation or creative graphs.

proposal_initiator.description: Experimental (media_buy.seller_offers). Absent means buyer. A seller-initiated proposal is an offer to amend or cancel an accepted media buy. It requires offer_reason, a media_buy_update or media_buy_cancellation proposal_kind, proposal_status committed (accepted once the buyer accepts it), and a proposal_id matching the proposal.offered notification_id pattern. Seller proposals into an open opportunity are a different surface (media_buy.open_opportunities). Sellers MUST NOT emit it to callers pinned below AdCP 3.3; a caller with no declared pin is treated as pinned below 3.3.

offer_reason.description: Experimental (media_buy.seller_offers). Why the seller made this offer. Present exactly when proposal_initiator is seller.

parent_proposal_id.description: Immediate predecessor this snapshot was forked from. Every proposal produced by refine_proposals carries it, equal to the request's source proposal_id, so negotiation lineage is reconstructible from proposals alone.

opportunity_id.description: Buyer planning cycle associated with this proposal. Revisions inherit it; it does not participate in proposal identity.

proposal_status.description: draft is indicative and unreserved; committed has firm terms with inventory reserved until expires_at; accepted is the historical snapshot attached to a MediaBuy.

expires_at.description: For a draft, the indicative-terms freshness deadline. For a committed proposal, the inventory-hold deadline; for a seller offer it is also the buyer's response deadline, after which the offer lapses and the signed terms stand.

terms_digest.description: Base64url SHA-256 digest of the RFC 8785 JCS serialization of commercial_terms, prefixed with sha256:.

total_budget_guidance.description: Optional budget guidance for this proposal — the planning answer to criteria.outcome_target and to open-budget briefs. commercial_terms.total_budget remains the concrete figure the plan is priced at; this band expresses the seller's recommended range around it. When criteria.outcome_target carries cost_per, the cost answer is commercial_terms.bidding.cost_per and this band's currency equals cost_per.currency.

forecast.description: Aggregate forecasted delivery for the proposal. For outcome_target requests, points carry the goal's metric or event key in metrics, or for a vendor_metric goal in vendor_metric_values[] plus metrics.spend; with cost_per, that is the goal volume planned under the commercial_terms.bidding policy, and currency equals cost_per.currency.
